title: Andhra Pradesh’s growth rate at 11.3%, ahead of Telangana’s, says Chandrababu Naidu
description: The Chief Minister said the growth rate had fallen to 10.3% between 2019 and 2024 from 13.5% in the preceding five years, and that ₹10,000 crore had been allocated for Amaravati and ₹8,300 crore for the Polavaram project
